pull_request.head: codex/agent-task-130-35764571579
pull_request.body:
Task request: https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/issues/130
Label request: `130-35764571579`

Refs #130; request 130-35764571579.

Found a concrete reuse candidate: 8,064 short-strip barrel modules share one strict local recipe. The unchanged tracker’s single instrumented baseline measured 25 s for mapping 46,682 sensitive paths, 30 s for initial cuts and 187 s for geometry closure/voxelization. Closure is the stronger target for a real-mother experiment; no tracker speedup is demonstrated.

Adds the report, compact results, hashes, reproduction scripts and controls under `docs/validation/tracker-placement-reuse/`. Updates the tracker README, software inventory, project tracking and paired session/interaction evidence. Governing records: DES-025, DES-043 and ADR-003. Detector geometry and configuration remain unchanged; raw artifacts stay local and ignored.

Validation: all five factory targets built; 22 tracker tests and three new controls passed; the corrected DDSim probe completed one event. Session, interaction and software-inventory validation passed, and the token preview built. Separate SoftEng and PhysVal assessments are retained.

Project-record validation remains blocked by pre-existing missing historical commit `78bc60bb6da0c9d234baf00d37cadea9dd4964b4`; the host must resolve that object/reference. No gate was weakened.

Human review should decide whether to commission isolated caching and real-mother A/B controls with containment, material, ID and ACTS checks. Timings have single-run/concurrent-workload limits. Exact task token counters were unavailable. No design sign-off is granted.
